description: Hand back your answers to tasks from llm_tasks, one entry per task id: {id, answer} with exactly the text the task asks for (answer_format json: one JSON value), or {id, error} when you cannot answer it (the flow then records the error for that item, as with a failing model). Up to 20 per call. The flow parses and checks the answer itself (e.g. evidence must be quoted verbatim from the passage). Returns per id whether it was delivered; a task of a cancelled run is reported as no longer open.

error.description: Instead of answer: why the task cannot be answered.

name: llm_answer
